name: css-blast-radius
description: Shows how many pages/elements a CSS rule change affects, live as you edit, backed by a local blast-radius daemon.

cssBlastRadius.siteRoot.description: Path (relative to the workspace root) containing the crawlable HTML site. Defaults to the workspace root.

cssBlastRadius.daemonPath.description: Optional path to a css-blast-radius-daemon executable/script. Defaults to the bundled backend.

cssBlastRadius.remoteEndpoint.description: Optional shared/remote index-service endpoint. When unset, the daemon runs fully local (see architecture doc, shared-team mode is descoped from this extension's v1).
